title: First Law Application
description: Essential: Student must correctly apply ΔU = Q + W (or Q = ΔU - W) for both processes.

title: Isothermal Process Recognition
description: Important: Student must recognize that for the ascent, constant temperature implies ΔU = 0 for an ideal gas.

title: Work Sign Convention
description: Important: Student must correctly interpret the sign of work (W negative when system does work on surroundings).

title: Ascent Heat Calculation
description: Essential: Final answer for part (1) must be 0.6 J.

title: Internal Energy Change
description: Essential: Final answer for part (2) must be 0.2 J.

title: Process Separation
description: Important: Student must treat the ascent and surface heating as distinct processes with separate First Law applications.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional: Student maintains consistent energy units (Joules) throughout calculations.

title: Sign Error Penalty
description: Pitfall: Incorrect sign for work (e.g., using W = +0.6J for ascent) leading to wrong Q or ΔU.

title: Energy Conservation Violation
description: Pitfall: Applying First Law in a form that violates energy conservation (e.g., ΔU = Q - W with wrong sign convention).
